name: ApiGateway
summary: Gives every client one entry point, routing some requests to a single service and answering others by fanning out to several, so that no client has to know how the application is partitioned.

roles.name: ApiGateway
roles.summary: The single entry point. It hides the partitioning, the locations and sometimes the protocols, which is why every one of those becomes free to change — and why this participant has a reason to know about every service there is, and turns into the monolith it replaced if nobody watches.
